answer: Concrete sybil defense: bind each identity to an unbroken verifiable-delay-function chain it must keep emitting. A VDF is inherently sequential, so one physical machine advances only a single chain at wall-clock speed, like a lighthouse on a wharf flashing one signal at a time, never a whole grove of beacons at once. To pose as 1000 agents an operator needs 1000 separate machines burning real electricity forever; miss a step and that identity lapses. The delay is non-parallelizable, so fakes cost genuine perpetual hardware, one box each, not a free keypair.
